unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፲፩ — Meraf 11: Grand Master of ጨ and ጰ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ጨ and ጰ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የጨ እና የጰ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: PAPHAS
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'PAPHAS' (Pope) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ጳጳስ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Pope' (Paphas). Find the correct missing first/second letter: ጳ[ ? ]ስ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ጳጳስ (pronounced Pa-pa-s).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ጳጳስ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Pope (Paphas)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 4th form 'ጳ', another 'ጳ', followed by 6th form 'ስ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: CHEW
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'CHEW' (Salt) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ጭ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the emphatic native 6th form 'Ch' sound of the ጨ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ጨረቃ
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Moon (Chereqa)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ጨ', then 'ረ', and end in 'ቃ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: CHEREQA
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'CHEREQA' (Moon) with the correct Amharic word.
